title: Diagonal biased placements can land outside the group radius — the 'candidate JOINS the estate' claim is false for ~1/3 of biased draws
evidence:
+				dir := growth_dir_pick(rng)
+				lo := GROWTH_MIN_SEP_TILES
+				hi := cat.balance.growth_groups.radius_tiles
+				if lo > hi {
+					lo = hi // degenerate guard — the loader already pins radius > sep
+				}
+				dist := rng_range(rng, lo, hi)
+				pos = t.node_pos[anchor_slot] + dir * dist
detail: Cluster adjacency is Euclidean (d0²+d1² <= r²), but dir may be diagonal {1,1} with dist up to radius_tiles=5: offset (5,5) is dist²=50 > 25, so the spawn does NOT join the cluster, contradicting the diff's own comment 'the candidate JOINS the estate in the derived view'.
recommended_fix: Draw a Euclidean distance and reject/scale diagonal offsets beyond radius, or verify dist²(dir*dist) <= r² and re-draw, so biased candidates provably land within radius of the anchor.

title: estate_surge.dem header quotes banner copy that does not match the shipped crises.json string
evidence:
+# shed stays AT THE SHARED UPLINK: the crisis engine names the uplink bundle,
+# the banner reads "Add a parallel pipe or a higher tier on the group
+# uplink's path — the surge is an aggregation event", and the player's fat
detail: The golden's header claims the banner includes '— the surge is an aggregation event', but the shipped copy in this same diff is only 'Add a parallel pipe or a higher tier on the group uplink's path.' (data/crises.json). Stale draft text in a blessed golden's documentation.
recommended_fix: Update the .dem header to quote the shipped crises.json preventive_redesign string verbatim, removing the trailing '— the surge is an aggregation event' clause.

title: Concentration control run discards its spawn total, so the 'strictly lower share' attribution lacks a volume sanity check
evidence:
+	estate_w, total_w := run_estate_concentration(42, 250, W)
+	estate_wo, total_wo := run_estate_concentration(42, 0, W)
+	_ = total_wo
detail: The weighted run asserts total_w > 1000, but the zeroed-weight control's total is discarded; if the control run spawned little streaming, the estate_w > estate_wo share comparison could attribute noise to the weight. Cheap non-vacuity check is missing.
recommended_fix: Assert total_wo > 1000 (or comparable to total_w) alongside the existing estate_w > estate_wo check so the attribution comparison rests on comparable control volume.
